553168c18b.why: Both the adjusted edi and final eax are preserved, along with the final addition flags and the effects of vzeroupper.

6727155cf1.why: Preserving edi, eax, the final addition flags, and the effects of vzeroupper prevents folding away any instruction.

7734175a5c.why: All loaded vectors, intermediate minima, the comparison mask, rcx, and the updated pointer are preserved, and ZF requires the final mask test.

d56190133c.why: The vector comparison, scalar mask, pointer difference, and mask-derived ZF are separate required outputs.

aafacffe73.why: Zeroing zmm16 and computing both comparison flags from the masked page offset require the existing four instructions.

53b5df7053.why: The loaded vectors, minima, both mask registers, and updated pointer are all preserved, with kortestd needed to produce the required ZF.

f2e38e7dc5.why: The preserved k2 and rdx require the comparison and mask transfer, followed by concatenation, trailing-zero count, and the flag-setting addition.

27a2b684d3.why: SSE2 requires separate zeroing of the four preserved vector registers, and the pointer copies, offset mask, and comparison are also required.

a58a40ac5d.why: The minimum reduction and byte comparison are required for xmm0, and SSE2 needs mask extraction plus a scalar test to produce ZF.

da3536e9b9.why: The comparison vectors and extracted masks in rsi, r8, and rcx are preserved, leaving no removable step in mask assembly, scanning, or the final flag-setting arithmetic.

6d025cd369.why: The saved count, both masked pointer offsets, all three vector constants, and comparison flags are required, with no shorter SSE2 combination.

d833273179.why: Each instruction supplies a distinct required output: the saved r9, two scalar constants, and the zeroed xmm0.

85b9e022bc.rewrite:
mov r11,r9
pxor xmm0,xmm0
mov rcx,0x10
mov r9d,0x1
lea r10,[rdi+0x1]
or r10,0xfffffffffffff000
85b9e022bc.why: For any 64-bit x, (x & 0xfff) - 0x1000 equals x | 0xfffffffffffff000. No flags must match, so one OR replaces the mask and subtraction.
